evals.name: delta-snowflake-airline
evals.prompt: Build me an account plan for Delta Air Lines — airline vertical, I sell Snowflake.
evals.expected_output: A single Markdown account plan following the fixed template (6 numbered sections + MEDDPICC snapshot + Sources), grounded in real, sourced research about Delta Air Lines, with Section 6 persona/entry-point guidance matching the data-platform category in the playbook.
expectations: Output is a Markdown file containing all required headers: Customer Information, Funding & Financial Position (or equivalent financial section), Organization Structure & Recent Changes, Decision-Maker Signals, Tech Stack, Entry Points & Persona to Pitch, MEDDPICC Snapshot, Sources
MEDDPICC Snapshot explicitly names all 8 elements: Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, Competition
Section 4 (Decision-Maker Signals) names at least one real, current or recent Delta Air Lines executive with a cited source
Section 2 reflects Delta being a public company (earnings/market cap/stock signals) rather than inventing VC-style funding rounds
Section 6 identifies an economic buyer/champion consistent with the data-platform persona mapping (e.g. CDO, CTO, VP Data/Analytics Engineering) rather than a generic or mismatched persona
A Sources section lists real, checkable citations (links or named publications)
No fabricated statistics presented as fact without a 'No public data found' or 'inferred' label where research came up short

expectations: Output is a Markdown file containing all required headers: Customer Information, Funding & Financial Position (or equivalent), Organization Structure & Recent Changes, Decision-Maker Signals, Tech Stack, Entry Points & Persona to Pitch, MEDDPICC Snapshot, Sources

evals.name: commbank-devin-fallback-persona
evals.prompt: I sell Devin (Cognition's AI coding agent) and I'm targeting Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank). Can you build an account plan?
evals.expected_output: A Markdown account plan following the fixed template, grounded in real research about CommBank. Devin/Cognition is not a listed category in the platform-persona playbook, so this tests the fallback reasoning method — the plan should still produce a sensible engineering-function economic buyer/champion/trigger via the fallback's 3-step reasoning rather than skipping Section 6 or forcing a bad-fit category.
expectations: Output is a Markdown file containing all required headers including MEDDPICC Snapshot and Sources
Section 6 is fully filled in (not skipped or marked as unavailable) despite Devin/Cognition not being a named category in the playbook
Section 6's persona is engineering-function-appropriate (e.g. CTO, VP Engineering as economic buyer; engineering manager/lead as champion) rather than a mismatched persona like CMO or CHRO
Section 4 names at least one real, current or recent CommBank executive with a cited source
The plan correctly identifies CommBank as an Australian financial institution and reflects that in vertical-relevant context (regulatory environment, market)
A Sources section lists real, checkable citations
